sentences.text: No: the Directions say a UCB shall not levy any charges or fees retrospectively at the time of pre-payment of loans that were waived off earlier by the UCB, and the same paragraph is headed for settlement of personal loans.
That pre-payment-charges paragraph applies to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, so the sanction date is needed to confirm whether it covers this loan.
